name: Garantiwebt AI
author: garantiwebtasarim

sections.description:
Garantiwebt AI is a WordPress plugin that helps you create high-quality, SEO-optimized articles using advanced AI models including Claude from Anthropic, OpenAI GPT-4, and Google Gemini.

Simply enter a keyword, select your language and tone, and let the AI generate a complete, well-structured article ready for publishing.

Key Features

  • Multiple AI Providers — Choose between Claude (Anthropic), OpenAI GPT-4, and Google Gemini
  • SEO-Optimized Content — Automatically structured with H2/H3 headings and optimal keyword placement
  • 36 Languages Supported — Generate content in English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, and 31 more
  • 14 Admin Languages — Plugin interface available in English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean
  • Automatic Featured Images — Pixabay integration adds relevant images to your articles automatically
  • Title Suggestions — AI-powered title recommendations for your keywords
  • Article History — Track all generated articles with status and SEO scores

Free vs Pro

The free version includes single article generation (up to 3 articles) with SEO scoring, featured images, and Claude/OpenAI/Gemini support.

Garantiwebt AI Pro unlocks:

  • Bulk Production — hundreds of articles at once
  • Autonomous Mode & WP-Cron scheduling
  • AI internal linking engine
  • SEO Engine (A+ to F scoring)
  • 5 AI Engines: AI Memory Core, Content DNA, ACF Engine AI, Elementor AI, WooCommerce AI
  • Multi-site support & priority support

Upgrade at garantiwebtasarim.com/garantiwebt-ai

What’s the difference between Free and Pro?

The free version offers single article generation (3 articles total). Pro adds bulk production, autonomous scheduling, AI internal linking, the SEO Engine, and 5 AI Engines (Memory Core, Content DNA, ACF, Elementor, WooCommerce), plus multi-site support. See garantiwebtasarim.com/garantiwebt-ai for plans.

How It Works

  1. Enter your API key from Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google in the Settings page
  2. Optionally add a Pixabay API key for automatic featured images
  3. Go to Generate Content and enter a keyword
  4. Select language, tone, word count, and other options
  5. Click “Generate Article” and watch the AI create your content

The article is saved as a WordPress post or page, complete with your selected category, status, and featured image.

Free and Unlimited

Garantiwebt AI is completely free. There are no article limits, no hidden costs, and no paid upgrades required to use the core features. You only pay your AI provider for API usage — typically between 1 and 10 cents per article.

Your API Keys Are Safe

All API keys are stored securely in your WordPress database and are never transmitted to our servers. The plugin communicates only with your chosen AI provider and Pixabay for images.

Supported Languages

36 languages including English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, and more.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services. Please review their terms and privacy policies before use.

Anthropic Claude API

Used to generate article content when Claude is selected as the AI provider.
Data sent: article keyword, language, tone, word count, and optional site context.
Sent when: user clicks “Generate Article” or runs Bulk Production.
Service: https://anthropic.com
Terms of Use: https://www.anthropic.com/news/updates-to-our-consumer-terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy

OpenAI API

Used to generate article content when OpenAI GPT is selected as the AI provider.
Data sent: article keyword, language, tone, word count, and optional site context.
Sent when: user clicks “Generate Article” or runs Bulk Production.
Service: https://openai.com
Terms of Use: https://openai.com/policies/usage-policies
Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

Google Gemini API

Used to generate article content when Gemini is selected as the AI provider.
Data sent: article keyword, language, tone, word count, and optional site context.
Sent when: user clicks “Generate Article” or runs Bulk Production.
Service: https://ai.google.dev
Terms of Use: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Pixabay API

Used to search and download a relevant featured image for generated articles.
Data sent: article keyword and your Pixabay API key.
Sent when: a new article is generated and Pixabay is selected as the image source.
This service is optional. If no API key is provided, no external image request is made.
Service: https://pixabay.com
Terms of Service: https://pixabay.com/service/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://pixabay.com/service/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the garantiwebt-ai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Garantiwebt AI > Settings and enter your API key from Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google.
  4. Optionally enter a Pixabay API key under Settings > Featured Image for automatic image insertion.
  5. Go to Garantiwebt AI > Generate Content and create your first article.
sections.faq:
Which AI provider gives the best results?

Claude from Anthropic is recommended for the best balance of quality, speed, and cost. GPT-4o is excellent for creative content. Gemini 1.5 Pro is a strong alternative with competitive API pricing.

Do I need my own API key?

Yes. Garantiwebt AI uses your own API keys from Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google. Your keys are stored securely in your WordPress database and are never transmitted to our servers.

How much does it cost per article?

The plugin itself is completely free. You pay your AI provider separately based on API usage. Typical cost per article ranges from 1 cent to 10 cents depending on the model and word count.

Can I generate content in multiple languages?

Yes. Garantiwebt AI supports 36 content languages. You can generate articles in different languages on the same WordPress installation.

Does the plugin add featured images automatically?

Yes. When a Pixabay API key is configured, the plugin searches Pixabay for a relevant photo and attaches it as the featured image. If no result is found, the article is published without a featured image.

Is my data safe?

Yes. Your API keys are stored only in your WordPress database. The only external communication is direct API calls to your chosen AI provider and Pixabay for images.

Does it work with Elementor and other page builders?

Yes. Garantiwebt AI creates standard WordPress posts and pages, fully compatible with Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, and any other theme or page builder.

What is the Bulk Production feature?

Bulk Production lets you add multiple keywords to a list and generate articles for all of them in a single session with one click. Each article is produced sequentially using the same settings.

2.1.0

  • Added Bulk Production feature for generating multiple articles from a keyword list
  • Added SEO analysis and meta description generator (SEO Tools tab)
  • Added internal link engine — AI automatically adds relevant internal links to generated articles
  • Added 36 content language support
  • Added 14 admin panel languages (EN, TR, DE, FR, ES, IT, PT, NL, PL, RU, AR, ZH, JA, KO)
  • Added Pixabay integration for automatic featured images
  • Improved AI prompt for higher quality structured content
  • Improved JSON response parsing for all AI providers
  • Added article history with SEO scores and status tracking
  • Added title suggestion feature

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Claude, OpenAI, and Gemini API integration
  • Single article generation with SEO scoring
